cases.description: Calling list.count for every value makes duplicate detection quadratic.

pull_request.title: Find duplicate values
pull_request.body: Return the duplicate values in an input list.

files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,6 @@
+def find_duplicates(values):
+    duplicates = []
+    for value in values:
+        if values.count(value) > 1 and value not in duplicates:
+            duplicates.append(value)
+    return duplicates

expected_findings.description: Repeated linear list.count calls inside the loop produce O(n squared) work.

cases.description: The value is parameterized and the dynamic sort column comes from a fixed allowlist.

pull_request.title: Add safe sorted user lookup
pull_request.body: Query users using a validated sort option.

files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,7 @@
+ALLOWED_SORTS = {'created': 'created_at', 'name': 'display_name'}
+
+def find_user(cursor, email, sort):
+    sort_column = ALLOWED_SORTS.get(sort)
+    if sort_column is None:
+        raise ValueError('unsupported sort')
+    return cursor.execute(f'SELECT * FROM users WHERE email = %s ORDER BY {sort_column}', (email,)).fetchall()
